VANN

240minutes
40solder joints
difficulty

A four-zone OpenSprinkler controller you solder yourself

Heat the pad and the pin together for two seconds. Feed solder into the joint, not onto the iron. Take the solder away first, then the iron.

Strip 3 mm, twist the strands, and tin the end before you solder it to a pad.

Unplug USB and disconnect any battery before you solder or change a wire. Work on a surface that does not burn, and wash your hands after handling solder.

26VANN-WIRE-1

Before you switch it on

  1. Look. Every joint is a shiny cone. No solder touches a neighbouring pad. No stray strands of wire.
  2. These must not beep. Set the multimeter to continuity and probe each pair. A beep means a short: find it before you plug in.
    3V3GND5VGND
  3. These must beep. Probe the two ends of every connection.
    3V3Controller 3V3 · Expander VCC · Display VCC
    GNDController G · Expander GND · Display GND
    I2C_SDAController 23 · Expander SDA · Display SDA
    I2C_SCLController 22 · Expander SCL · Display SCL
    5VController 5V · Relays DC+
    GNDController G.4 · Relays DC- · R3 10k 2
    ZONE1Expander P00 · Relays IN1
    ZONE2Expander P01 · Relays IN2
    ZONE3Expander P02 · Relays IN3
    ZONE4Expander P03 · Relays IN4
    SN1_PULLUPController 4 · R1 10k 1
    SENSOR1R1 10k 2 · Rain sensor terminal 1 · Controller 1
    GNDRain sensor terminal 3 · Controller G.2
    CURR_SENSEController 0 · R3 10k 1
  4. Plug in. Nothing gets warm, nothing smells. If something does, unplug at once and go back to step 2.
  5. Flash the bring-up test. It reports every part it can find before you load the real firmware.pio run -e bringup -t upload && pio device monitor
27VANN-WIRE-1

Vann is built

Vann is the control box of a garden watering system: four relays switch four 24 V AC valves on schedules set from a phone, and a rain sensor stops watering when it is not needed. It is wired to match OpenSprinkler 4.0, so it runs the unmodified upstream OpenSprinkler firmware on an ESP32-C6. It lives indoors or in a shed; the valves live outside in a valve box.
